result.title: Joint Client Scheduling and Resource Allocation for Optimal Federated Learning over Wireless Networks
result.comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Revised author-prepared version of a paper accepted and presented at IEEE FLTA 2026
result.summary: Federated learning often relies on partial client participation because full participation is costly in cross-device wireless systems with limited uplink resources, heterogeneous channel conditions, energy constraints, and strict upload deadlines. However, partial participation introduces sampling variance, causing the sampled update to deviate from the full-participation update. Existing optimal client sampling methods reduce this variance but usually rely on simplified client-count budgets, while wireless-aware scheduling methods account for communication constraints but do not directly optimize sampling variance. This paper proposes resource-aware optimal client sampling (RAOCS), a unified variance-minimizing client scheduling framework under uplink resource-block, round deadline, update-information, and energy constraints. The resulting problem admits a capped water-filling solution that balances client update importance, wireless resource cost, and energy feasibility. Experimental results demonstrate that RAOCS achieves accuracy comparable to that of OCS while reducing the average upload time per iteration by more than a factor of 252.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究无线网络中联邦学习的客户端调度与资源分配，提出统一的上行资源块、轮次期限、更新信息量与能量约束下最小化采样方差的选择框架 RAOCS，并给出带上限的注水式解，在精度接近 OCS 的同时大幅降低每次迭代上传时间。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 无直接关联，但其「在资源预算下选择子集以最小化对整体更新的偏差、并按重要性与成本做注水解分配」的表述，可能为 latent 推理中的视觉证据筛选、支持组合或动态计算预算分配提供形式化类比，可供核查。
